metadata.question: What did the IFPI report say about global music revenue in 2025?

response.summary: The IFPI Global Music Report 2026 states that global recorded music revenues reached an all-time high of US$31.7 billion in 2025. This marked the first time these revenues surpassed US$30 billion, with a growth rate of 6.4% in 2025, which was an improvement over the 4.7% growth rate in 2024 (Source 2: IFPI Global Music Report 2026, p.4).
